name: Slingshot
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The Twitter account of decentralized exchange Slingshot has been compromised by scammer Pink Drainer, who posted links to fake websites and claimed that users could claim airdrop tokens. Users are advised to be aware of the risks and not to click on the links.
